newsitem.title: USA: US late spot prods gain on bullish API data.
newsitem.headline: US late spot prods gain on bullish API data.

text.p: U.S. late spot refined products gained moderate ground late Wednesday as the market bullishly interpreted weekly API data showing a 827,000 barrel drop in distillate stocks and a 2.9 million barrel decline in gasoline, players said.

December heating oil futures in after-hours ACCESS trade rose about 0.70 cent a gallon, while December gasoline moved 0.55-cent higher after release late afternoon of API data for the week ending Nov 8.
Gulf traders predicted the solid draw on gasoline stocks would likely help strengthen differentials on "M4"-grade conventional unleaded when trading resumes in earnest Thursday.
The primary Gulf gasoline grade had firmed two cents a gallon Wednesday even before release of the API weekly data.
"The market had taken off in advance of the APIs, so the numbers just support the longs," one Gulf player said.

He noted refiners and traders, including Wall Street broker Morgan Stanley, have been snapping up big parcels on a daily basis for the past week amid tight supply attributed to refinery problems and recent refiner focus on distillate production.
